# Generated Yarn Berry registry fixture

Generated with Yarn 4.5.0 using `yarn install --mode=skip-build` against a
local test npm registry. The local registry served deterministic React,
ReactDOM, and scheduler tarballs; no external network or package scripts were
used to generate this lockfile. It covers two versions of React and ReactDOM,
workspace edges, npm aliases, transitive dependencies, and Yarn Berry's lock
checksums. Berry lock entries do not preserve registry origin, so the resolver
must retain package identities while marking origin confidence unknown.
